metadata.description: A live task-queue pane for a Claude Code session, which also follows the sessions it hands tasks to, and a guard against re-writing an expired prompt cache

plugins.name: task-queue
plugins.description: A live pane with the session's task queue and open questions, kept by Claude; for tasks handed to other sessions, their context fill, idle time and /compact readiness

plugins.name: stale-cache-guard
plugins.description: Hooks that stop a prompt or a SendMessage from re-writing a large context whose prompt cache has expired, unless the owner allows it
